acceptance: RED first: a changed function that calls syscall.Kill is never passed to gremlins (test with a fake runner seam, no real mutation of kill code)
A fake gremlins report of 8 killed, 2 lived, 1 not covered gives TQ1 0.80 with the Wilson bounds over 10 mutants and not_covered=1
TQ3 counts a test with zero unique kills
The index starts at stage shadow and emits no breach
No test in this item runs real gremlins on this repository
The fake runner is always handed a path outside the plane tree and outside main
A changed function in a file that contains a kill call elsewhere is excluded; a body that does not parse is refused
fix: Run gremlins (~/go/bin) only in a scratch worktree of the ship commit, never in the plane or main tree, at the boundary on the packages of each ship of the closing wave, limited to the changed line ranges, with a time budget. TIMED OUT counts as killed, NOT COVERED is its own count, NOT VIABLE is dropped. Refuse any function whose body calls syscall.Kill, unix.Kill, os.Process.Kill or os.Process.Signal, and the packages go/internal/proctree, go/internal/bridge (dispatch_reap.go) and go/internal/gc. A budget overrun emits quality.warning. Exclude by file and by package as well as by body: a file that contains a kill call is excluded whole. Callee reachability is out of scope; a body that does not parse is refused, not passed through.
